response.sql: WITH gender_invoiced_orders AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as invoiced_order_count FROM Customers c INNER JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) as avg_value FROM gender_invoiced_orders), above_average AS (SELECT gio.invoiced_order_count, oa.avg_value FROM gender_invoiced_orders gio CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE gio.invoiced_order_count > oa.avg_value) SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) as avg_invoiced_order_count, AVG(invoiced_order_count - avg_value) as avg_excess FROM above_average
